titleEn: I Need to Give It Back

pages.text: Ppino lent Soso a sled. "Give it back after your ride."
Soso had lots of rides down the slope. Now it was time to return it.
Ppino stood over there. Soso walked toward Ppino, then stopped.
Soso didn't know what to say. Holding the sled, Soso turned away.
The next day, Soso turned away with the sled again. And the day after.
The sled stayed outside Soso's house. Soso didn't even ride it anymore.
Ppino rode on Rudi's sled, the two squeezed on together. Soso watched from far away.
Grandma Bear put the sled rope in Soso's hand. "Give it back, and you can borrow again."
Soso set the sled in front of Ppino. "I had fun. Thank you."
Ppino put the sled on the slope. "Have another ride. Let's ride together."
